items.title: Burke Stevenson Interview, 1959-06-12
items.q: I can remember a lot of the fellas played with Louis. It was Kid Oral.

ctx.x: Is that near, uh, Grab here, up in that, uh, uh, That's right, that's right. Near the Pelican across the town.
Yeah, that's right. Yeah. Um. And Louis, he took the band over after, after Joe had left from here. I can remember a lot of the fellas played with Louis. It was Kid Oral. Oh yeah.
